List of the LOINC Linguistic Variants that are available and their producers (translators).

Source: R/data.R
linguistic_variants.Rd

LOINC Linguistic Variants are provided by an international community of volunteer translators.

Usage

linguistic_variants

Format

A tibble with 5 fields

VariableDescription
IDThe unique identifier for a particular language variant within the LOINC database. This identifier does not have any meaning outside of LOINC.
ISO_LANGUAGEThe ISO language code
ISO_COUNTRYThe ISO-2C country code
LANGUAGE_NAMEA combination of the name of the language and the country in which that variant is used
PRODUCERThe person or organisation that provided the translation

Examples

linguistic_variants
#>    ID ISO_LANGUAGE ISO_COUNTRY                LANGUAGE_NAME
